title: Balance onboarding prototype: Insight Timer's flow
intro: Insight Timer's onboarding flow, rebuilt in Balance's skin, from welcome to today's paywall. Built from the Insight Timer teardown without a talk-over, and not yet reviewed. Two versions: the wish list as we'd build it with no template limits, and a constrained version that uses only card templates already in the app.
note: The flows and their cost estimates were drafted with Claude and have not had an engineering review. Copy in [brackets] is a placeholder to verify.
